first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A first-person gun wielder, with a beige long-sleeved forearm and a tan-brown hand in contact with Weapon B visible at the bottom of the frame.

entities.name: light-brown courtyard road
entities.identification: The gray-brown to light-brown ground around the pile and at the foot of the wall.

entities.name: high-walled building with blue-gray trim
entities.identification: The beige building on the left, with a curved wall surface nearby and a blue-gray eave edge visible at the top.

entities.name: pile of bag-like bundles and light-colored wooden crates
entities.identification: Multiple layers of tan-brown rectangular bundles stacked on light-colored wooden crates, which have upward arrows and multiple dark hole marks.

entities.name: courtyard wall
entities.identification: The beige wall on the right side of the frame, with light-colored papers attached, scattered dark dot-like marks, and loops of wire along the top.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The long black rifle held by Person A, located in the lower-right foreground, with a top rail, front and rear sights, and a gray cylindrical rear section visible.

entities.name: arched courtyard side gate
entities.identification: A partially exposed arched doorway behind and to the right of the pile, with a relatively dark interior.

entities.name: yellow human-shaped outline marker
entities.identification: A group of glowing yellow human-shaped outlines overlaid on the wall and crate areas.

entities.name: blue trajectory line
entities.identification: A thin bright-blue line extending upward in the frame from the right edge of the pile near the doorway.

entities.name: wall-top trees
entities.identification: Green crowns and branches visible behind the wall; yellow-green palm-like long leaves are also visible along the upper edge in frame 0.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light-blue to nearly white background areas visible between the building eaves, wall top, and tree crowns.
